description: Guide a student to implement a composite multi-signal strategy across the full 635-symbol Binance futures universe on LEAN, then run a systematic parameter sweep over the benchmark's 19 predefined weight combinations. The student must implement three signal components per symbol (trend via SMA crossover, mean-reversion via RSI, and carry via real funding rates), implement cross-sectional position sizing (not per-symbol independent sizing), and structure a sweep workflow that matches the shipped reference configurations. This is the most complex I-series task, testing everything: multi-signal construction, universe-scale, point-in-time-safe carry construction, and systematic optimization.

student_openings.beginner_no_finance: I want to combine different trading signals — like trend, mean-reversion, and funding carry — and test many parameter combinations across all 635 crypto futures in my dataset. How do I set this up on LEAN?
student_openings.intermediate_developer: I'm implementing a composite signal strategy on LEAN across 635 crypto futures, combining trend, mean-reversion, and real funding-rate carry signals. I need to run the benchmark weight sweep over those signals. How should I structure the universe-wide algorithm and the sweep workflow?
student_openings.advanced_quant: I'm building a multi-signal alpha on LEAN across the full 635-future universe and I need to sweep the shipped benchmark weight configurations using real funding carry without look-ahead leakage. What's the architecture?

ground_truth.expected_outcome: Student produces (1) a LEAN C# algorithm that computes all three signals per symbol (trend via SMA crossover, reversion via RSI deviation, carry via real funding rates) and implements cross-sectional position sizing, (2) a parameter sweep mechanism running the 19 benchmark weight combinations, (3) a sweep results table with Sharpe/drawdown/return/turnover per combination, and (4) detailed results for the best configuration. The default benchmark configuration (0.4/0.3/0.3) trade log for 10 reference symbols should match the ground-truth.
required_capabilities: Implement three signal components per symbol (trend, reversion, real funding carry) with proper normalization at universe scale
Implement cross-sectional position sizing (signal strength relative to universe, not independent)
Combine signals with configurable weights and structure the 19-run benchmark parameter sweep
Manage daily rebalancing across all 635 symbols with leverage constraints
Produce structured sweep results and identify optimal configurations
